objective: 把 AFL 的素材交付层从“16 张全尺寸 PNG + 运行时全尺寸 mask 合成”重构为可校验、可缓存、按需加载的素材库，并修复最影响观赛的 rig 表达与默认调试层。

workItems.title: Freeze the asset contract and inventory
workItems.outcome: Source plates are separated from web-served derivatives; manifest schema, directory layout, byte budgets and the decision record are frozen.
completionCriteria: assets/source/plates/fighters contains 16 plates and assets/source/plates/stage contains 1 stage plate
assets/compat/rig contains the frozen legacy rig.json and mask.png for all 16 fighters
docs/asset-library.md documents the manifest, paths, budgets, cache headers, rig schema 2 and fallback chain
docs/plans/2026-11-09-asset-library.decision.json records the A/B/C decision

workItems.title: Build content-addressed derivatives and the manifest
workItems.outcome: npm run assets:build produces play/card/stage derivatives, a canonical manifest and a reproducible --check path; byte budgets pass with WebP alternates.
completionCriteria: web/assets/manifest.json exists and contains 16 fighters plus the stage
web/assets total <= 8MB
totals.liveViewBytes <= 1.5MB with WebP alternates
totals.galleryViewBytes <= 2.5MB with WebP alternates
assets:build twice produces the same revision and hashes
assets:check writes no files and exits 0

workItems.title: Pre-bake rig atlases and improve articulation
workItems.outcome: The browser loads a padded part atlas plus compact schema-2 JSON; runtime mask decoding is gone; attacks read clearly and the worst part-ownership errors are fixed.
completionCriteria: web/assets/v/rig/<id>/atlas.* and rig.<hash>.json exist for all 16 fighters
No runtime request for mask.png on the new client
verify:anim passes
rig lab idleVsHp > 1500 and idleVsWalk > 800 for all 16 fighters
coral/tide/forge overlay screenshots show corrected ownership
Every part rotation stays inside its clamp and no pose is empty

workItems.title: Serve manifest, immutable assets and legacy aliases
workItems.outcome: The server validates the manifest, serves hashed assets as immutable, handles ETag/304/gzip, and keeps the old art/rig URLs working.
completionCriteria: /assets/manifest.json returns 200 with no-cache and ETag
/assets/v/** returns immutable cache headers and Content-Length
A matching If-None-Match returns 304
Legacy /assets/art/<id>.png and /assets/rig/<id>/rig.json return 200
Text responses gzip when Accept-Encoding allows it
npm run verify still passes 22/22

workItems.title: Load only the active match and lazy-load the gallery
workItems.outcome: Live view requests only the two active fighters plus stage and rig; the gallery loads cards on view activation; a missing rig falls back to the whole plate.
completionCriteria: Live resource entries contain only two fighter plays, two rigs and the stage
Live first-view transfer <= 1.5MB with WebP
Gallery loads 16 card images after the fighters view is activated
Missing rig renders the whole sprite, never a blank body
npm run verify:art passes with the updated expectations

workItems.title: Make the default view a broadcast, not a debug tool
workItems.outcome: Debug overlays default off, the technical view is one click, the stage/character contrast is stronger, and hit/block/KO/super have an optional procedural sound track.
completionCriteria: showBoxes/showBones/showRuler/showGrid default false
A technical-view button enables all debug overlays at once
Stage vignette and fighter spotlight are visible in screenshots
The sound toggle enables WebAudio without autoplay errors
Desktop 1440x1250 and mobile 390x844 screenshots have no overflow

workItems.title: Run the full acceptance suite and archive evidence
workItems.outcome: All existing and new checks pass; screenshots, byte reports and AIOS evidence point to real artifacts.
completionCriteria: npm run verify = 22/22
npm run verify:combat = 34/34
npm run verify:art passes
npm run verify:anim passes
npm run verify:assets passes
npm run verify:mcp = 15/15
Desktop and mobile screenshots are archived

blocked.reason: waiting for the frozen asset contract
waiting for the frozen rig schema
waiting for build, rig and server artifacts
waiting for all delivery work items

convergenceGate.verification: npm run assets:check && npm run verify && npm run verify:combat && npm run verify:art && npm run verify:anim && npm run verify:assets && npm run verify:mcp
convergenceGate.joinCondition: All seven work items are complete, every command exits 0, and the archived screenshots/manifest match the delivered revision.
